context.question: Who will win the UK general election of 4 July 2024?
context.setting: A snap general election was called on 22 May 2024 for 4 July. Labour under Keir Starmer leads the governing Conservatives under Rishi Sunak by roughly twenty points in the polls. Sunak has been criticised for leaving the D-Day memorial service early. The election falls in the Sun sign Cancer.

provenance.work: Jessica Adams, 'Top 16 Astrology Predictions of 2024' (Substack) quoting her Substack post of 18 June 2024; mirrored in 'Top Psychic Astrology Predictions of 2024', jessicaadams.com, 31 Dec 2024
